Adds `research/twin-certification` (builds on RECUV / Autonomous Systems IRT safe-autonomy-with-verification directions; no affiliation implied).

- Worst-case false-certification probability of any `k ≤ c` rule is exactly `P(Bin(n,ε) ≤ c)`; by Karlin–Rubin a twin prior cannot cut real trials at a fixed level.
- ε=0.01, δ=0.05: exact zero-failure test needs 299 trials; a twin power prior reaches 133 only at worst-case size 0.26; the exact test held to the same size needs the same n (1057 vs 1057).
- Jeffreys credible bound is already anti-conservative (size 0.147 at 191 trials); optimistic twins inflate size, pessimistic ones block certification; largest safe twin weight computed.
- 11 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok; README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added. Stylised, no real trial data.
